The '''bubble city''' was an enclosed city in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] passed it on its way to [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].

==Behind the scenes==
The city was located further from the [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] than was [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was either a space station, or was located on one of the moons of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] which could not support life since the city required a dome.
